definition.material_scope: assumed SI demonstration parameters, not a calibrated impact or fracture experiment

geometry.phase_definition: 0 matrix, 1 homogenized yarn; fully infiltrated, no void phase
geometry.orientation_definition: columns: reference centreline tangent, in-plane transverse, their right-handed cross product
geometry.projection_scope: all material particles checked against exact yarn strips and normal-plane ellipse ownership

unit_cell.diameter_rule: diameter >= 10 times the longer complete orthogonal repeating-cell edge
unit_cell.scope: geometric repeat with family identity; individual yarn IDs relabel under translation

surface_audit.scope: sampled surface exclusion and local curvature bound; not a continuous collision proof

periodic_geometry_audit.scope: sampled periodic-cell surface exclusion and actual path-translation checks; not an exhaustive continuous nonintersection proof; all plate particles have exact ownership checks

clamp.corner_assignment: first matching owner; one impulse per node

tool.kind: finite-mass rigid hollow sphere; illustrative mass independent of diameter

pressure.scope: vertical dead traction on fixed-reference top particles inside the four clamp bands

definition.scope: coarse structural demonstration; fixed 2mm physical thickness and actual rigid-tool inertia

rigid_spheres.motion_source: actual integrated finite-mass sphere states; no imposed impact trajectory

output_scope: damage is identically zero and temperature fixed because the elastic woven model has neither damage nor heat evolution
energy_scope: APIC translational and affine kinetic energy and woven stored energy; separate contact loss, fixed-grid projection loss and actual discrete particle external work.
angular_momentum_scope: radial frictionless sphere has no spin degree of freedom; global fixture angular-impulse closure is not reported
